## Scientific hypothesis or correction

## Payoff and settlement semantics
- [ ] Common settlement state space documented
- [ ] Market-derived inputs clearly separated from synthetic examples
- [ ] If MOT is used, underlying is tradeable and discount/funding assumptions specified

## Reproducibility
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] Numerical tolerance and solver parameters documented
- [ ] Primal and complete dual certificates checked

## Evidence and claims
- [ ] Relevant literature cited, with novelty limitations
- [ ] No market arbitrage claimed without executable quote/depth/fee checks
- [ ] Human review of manuscript changes before publication
